description:
A) Screen purpose and type:
This is a login screen for the Al Jazeera mobile app, designed to allow users to log in with their Al Jazeera account details.

B) Layout top to bottom:
1. Status bar at the top with system notifications.
2. App bar with the title "Log In" and a back arrow on the left.
3. Al Jazeera logo and text "Login with your Al Jazeera account details" centered in the middle.
4. Email address field with placeholder text "appcrawler2@gmail.com" and a password field with placeholder text "Crowd3456".
5. "Log In" button in an orange rectangular container.
6. "Forgot your password?" link at the bottom.

C) Component inventory (grouped):
1. Title and back arrow in the app bar.
2. Al Jazeera logo and login text.
3. Email address and password fields.
4. "Log In" button.
5. "Forgot your password?" link.

D) Visual design (colors, typography, background):
1. The background is white.
2. The app bar and title use a dark orange color.
3. The Al Jazeera logo is in a golden color.
4. The text is primarily in a dark gray color, with the "Log In" button in a lighter shade of orange.
5. The placeholder text in the email and password fields is in a lighter gray color.

E) Accessibility observations:
1. The text in the email and password fields is not high contrast, which may be an accessibility concern for users with low vision.
2. The "Forgot your password?" link is clearly labeled and accessible.

F) Primary actions + navigation:
1. The primary action is to "Log In" by tapping the "Log In" button.
2. Navigation includes the back arrow in the app bar to return to the previous screen.

Recap:
- Screen type/purpose: Login screen for the Al Jazeera mobile app.
- Key components: Email address and password fields, "Log In" button, "Forgot your password?" link.
- Primary CTA(s): "Log In" button.
- Navigation/footer: Back arrow in the app bar, "Forgot your password?" link at the bottom.
- Dominant colors: White background, dark orange app bar, golden Al Jazeera logo, dark gray text.
- Typography: Roboto font, heading ~24sp, body ~16sp, caption ~12sp.
- Accessibility flags: Low contrast text in the email and password fields.
